Title: CReM mutate-based structure generation
Description: Generates analogues of an input molecule by replacing one fragment of up to ten heavy atoms with alternatives observed in the same local chemical context in ChEMBL, the MUTATE operation of Polishchuk's CReM framework. Replacements are drawn from a library restricted to synthetically accessible fragments, so analogues are chemically valid by construction, but no ring system missing from that library can appear. Where more than a hundred are produced, Ersilia clusters them and keeps one per cluster, so repeated runs return different sets.
Interpretation: Up to 100 analogues of the input, each differing by one fragment swapped from a ChEMBL-derived library.
